finding.title: Hohpe, Fowler. AC-C1 cannot pass for the P0 deliverables as the spec describes them. AC-C1 requires zero matches of `orca(-ide) orchestration|worktree|terminal|agent` under `src/superclaude/core` (`spec:172`), while P0 adds `WORKER-CONTRACT.md` to `core/` (`spec:52`, `spec:158`) and an "Orca section" to `HOW-WE-WORK.md` in `core/` (`spec:158`), and SA-2 explicitly allows Orca mentions in the contract file (`spec:147`). Any natural Orca section that names a coordinator command trips the check. Recommend: align the grep paths with SA-2 or exclude the two named files.

e1.context:
### 2.1 Terms
- **Worker run**: a session that received an Orca preamble carrying a Task ID and a Dispatch ID. Only such a session may send lifecycle messages; a session the user started, inside or outside Orca, is an ordinary session (`CAPS:148`, `[G]` lines 38 and 41).
- **Unattended mode**: the behaviour a command switches to when its caller passes `--unattended`. It is the only command-side change the contract asks for besides report files and resume. It names no Orca command, so the same mode serves any caller that has no person at the keyboard. How the mode is selected (flag versus detecting the preamble) is open decision D1 in section 9; this spec is written for the recommended flag.
- **Contract file**: one shared document, proposed as `src/superclaude/core/WORKER-CONTRACT.md`, installed to `~/.claude/WORKER-CONTRACT.md`. Core `.md` files install to `~/.claude/` (`src/superclaude/cli/install_core.py:4,33`; `CLAUDE.md:83,408`), and the new name must be added to `KNOWN_CORE_FILES` (`src/superclaude/cli/install_core.py:13-24`). Each changed command adds a short `## Unattended mode` section that lists only its own gate resolutions and report file and points to the installed contract path, so the shared rules are written once.

### 2.2 Requirements
Each requirement says what the command must do, what the worker session (the top-level agent that received the preamble) must do, and the evidence.
